name: Closed Cases Total
query:
SELECT
    u.full_name AS "Case Owner",
    i.case_owner AS "Email",
    COUNT(*) AS "Closed Issue Count",
    i.case_number AS "Case Number",
    i.date_and_time_closed AS "Date/Time Closed"
FROM
    `tabIssue` i
JOIN
    `tabUser` u ON i.case_owner = u.email
WHERE
    i.status = 'Closed'
    AND u.enabled = 1
    AND i.date_and_time_closed >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
GROUP BY
    u.full_name, i.case_owner
ORDER BY
    "Closed Issue Count" DESC;
